identity.title: Pokémon the Movie: The Power of Us: Zeraora's Story

leadText: Pokémon the Movie: The Power of Us: Zeraora's Story (Japanese: Pocket Monsters the Movie: Everyone's Story Side Story - Episode Zeraora) is a short tie-in adaptation of the twenty-first Pokémon movie, The Power of Us. It is adapted by Kemon Kawamoto.
